datatype TreeNode = Leaf | Node(val: int, left: TreeNode, right: TreeNode)

function SumPath(root: TreeNode, target: int): bool
  decreases root
{
  match root
  case Leaf =>
    false
  case Node(v, left, right) =>
    // Check if the value in the current node is the target
    v == target
    // Recursively check left and right subtrees with the same target
    || SumPath(left, target) || SumPath(right, target)
}

function Main() {
  // Example 1: Tree with path sum 22
  var tree1 := Node(5,
    Node(4,
      Node(11,
        Node(7, Leaf, Leaf),
        Node(8, Leaf, Leaf)),
      Node(2,
        Node(5,
          Node(10, Leaf, Leaf),
          Node(3, Leaf, Leaf)),
        Node(1, Leaf, Leaf)),
    Node(6,
      Node(1,
        Node(5, Leaf, Leaf),
        Node(2, Leaf, Leaf)),
      Node(1, Leaf, Leaf)),
    Node(1, Leaf, Leaf));
  
  assert SumPath(tree1, 24) { "pathSum_1 = true" }
  assert SumPath(tree1, 25) { "pathSum_1 = false" }

  var tree2 := Node(10,
    Node(3,
      Node(10, Leaf, Leaf),
      Node(15, Leaf, Leaf)),
    Node(6,
      Node(1,
        Node(5, Leaf, Leaf),
        Node(2, Leaf, Leaf)),
      Node(1, Leaf, Leaf)));

  assert SumPath(tree2, 12) { "pathSum_2 = true" }
  assert SumPath(tree2, 14) { "pathSum_2 = false" }

  Main();
